'''''Meditations on a Padawan's Journey''''' was a text written by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Alaqua]] sometime before the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
